# retrieval-debugger

> Explain why a document was or was not retrieved for a query: its rank against
> the cutoff, per-term exact, accent and stem matches, missing terms and terms
> cut off by chunking. Python distribution `trysac-retrieval-debugger`, import
> name `retrieval_debugger`, version 0.1.0, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no
> runtime third-party dependencies.
